posts.title: Story of the Month: A Hollwo Earth Thanksgivinw
posts.description: This month's Story of the Month goes right with Thanksgiving, my favorite winter holiday, and is my hollow earth action/adventure story " A Hollow Earth Thanksgiving ". Fair warning, this is the third one in the series and things do change, so there are some details of previous stories there, but it stands alone just fine and is a nice story for this holiday. posts.title: Story of the Month: A Grave Kind of Love
posts.description: To go along with my on-going Kickstarter , my story of the month is "A Grave Kind of Love." This is one of the 29 stories being released in three volumes and part of this Kickstarter! (BTW, the Kickstarter is funded, doing great, and we are into some fun stretch goals) And since this is a special one, the story is free to read on my website for two weeks, until 11/7/2026.
